Technology & communication 3

Scroll, post, and stay sharp about what's real online. This page runs from social media — putting up a โพสต์ (post), getting people to กดไลก์ (tap like) and แชร์ (share) it, following a ช่อง (channel) for its คอนเทนต์ (content) — to the risks: a dodgy ลิงก์ (link), a fake caller who's really a มิจฉาชีพ (scammer), the แก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์ (call-center gang). It ends on how all this shapes daily life — เอไอ (AI) at work, hours lost to โซเชียล (social media), and the urge to switch off. All 24 sentences come with native-speed audio, English translations, and word-by-word notes, so the online-life vocabulary sticks by ear.

แก๊งคอลเซ็นเตอร์ (call-centre gangs) are a major issue in Thailand — organised phone-scam operations, often run from across the border, impersonating banks, police or couriers. ระบาด ('to spread like an epidemic') is the word regularly used for them.
